file_contract: host_inputs final component not symlink; fixed regular file single hardlink; no file symlink/special file; inode/size/mtime/ctime stable during read. Not source authentication.
unit_ref: nonempty UTF8 str, unique in document
sku: G[0-9a-f]{8}; duplicate SKU across distinct units allowed
category_path: nonempty UTF8 str OR nonempty list of nonempty UTF8 str
money: price integer>=1; standard_fee null or integer>=0, bool rejected
expiry: null or integer>=0; remaining=max(0,expires_at-as_of); unknown remainsnull; expired available is labelledexpired
filters: optional SKU list<=200; explicit[] means matchnone. min_remaining excludes null expiry and expiry<=now even at0, but does not exclude reserved/sold_out.
pagination: next_args carries raw original-array offset, snapshot digest; source changes reject. MUST merge original named carry_filters when present; original permission description is incomplete.
fragment: row_fragment.text1600-character chunks of ensure_ascii JSON; concatenate in offset order then JSON-parse; row as_of remains stable; caller must still check current expiry before commerce.
